The {{Nihongo|'''Soul Society: The Rescue arc'''|{{Ruby-ja|尸魂界|ソウル・ソサエティ}}・救出篇|Sōru Sosaeti: Kyūshutsu-hen}} is the third season of the ''[[Bleach (TV series)|Bleach]]'' [[anime]] television series. In the English adaptation of the anime released by [[Viz Media]], the title is changed to simply '''The Rescue'''.<ref name="VizMediaVol11">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7469 |title=Viz Media . products - Bleach, Vol. 11 (DVD) |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=2008-09-25 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090210165902/http://viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7469 |archive-date=2009-02-10 }}</ref> The episodes are directed by [[Noriyuki Abe]], and produced by [[TV Tokyo]], [[Dentsu]], and [[Studio Pierrot]].<ref name="staff">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/staff.html|title=ぴえろ Bleach =ブリーチ=|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=2009-04-07}}</ref> The season adapts [[Tite Kubo]]'s ''[[Bleach (manga)|Bleach]]'' [[manga]] series from the rest of the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol14|14th]] volume to the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol21|21st]] volume (chapters 118–182), with the exception of episode 50 ([[Filler (media)|filler]]). The season follows [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] defending [[Rukia Kuchiki]] from [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach|Soul Reapers]] in the [[Bleach (manga)#Setting|Soul Society]].

The season aired from July 2005 to January 2006 on TV Tokyo. The English adaptation of the season began airing in July 2007 on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Adult Swim]] in the United States.<ref>{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2006-03-30/adult-swim-picks-up-bleach|title=Adult Swim Picks up Bleach|date=2006-03-30|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=2009-04-12}}</ref> In October 2007 the series went on a hiatus; episodes resumed airing in March 2008 and finished in May of the same year.<ref name="BleachHiatus">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2008-01-28/adult-swim-to-run-52-more-episodes-of-bleach|title=Adult Swim to Run 52 More Episodes of Bleach|website=[[Anime News Network]]|date=2008-01-28|access-date=2008-09-25}}</ref>

The episodes use four pieces of theme music: two opening themes and two ending themes. The opening theme for the first ten episodes is "D-TecnoLife" by [[Uverworld]];<ref name="music1">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=Bleach～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050626235715/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2005-06-26|language=ja }}</ref> the other episodes of the season use {{Nihongo|"[[Ichirin no Hana]]"|一輪の花|Single Flower}} by [[High and Mighty Color]].<ref name="music2">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=Bleach～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051013065149/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2005-10-13|language=ja }}</ref> The two ending themes are "HappyPeople" by Skoop on Somebody, used from episode 42 to 51,<ref name="music1" /> and [[Yui (singer)|Yui]]'s "[[Life (Yui song)|Life]]", which was used for the remainder of the episodes.<ref name="music2" />

Five DVD compilations, each containing four episodes of the season, with the exception of the last two discs with contain five episodes, were released by [[Aniplex]] between December 21, 2005, to April 26, 2006.<ref name="AmazonJPDVD1">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B000BPK5O0|title=BLEACH 尸魂界 救出篇 1|language=ja|access-date=2008-09-25}}</ref><ref name="AmazonJPDVD5">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B000EHTA0K|title=BLEACH 尸魂界 救出篇 5|language=ja|access-date=2008-09-25}}</ref> The English adaptation of the anime is distributed by Viz Media; three DVD compilations have been released on July 22, September 23, and November 18, 2008, respectively.<ref name="ManiaVol11">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.mania.com/bleach-vol-11_article_80361.html|title=Bleach Vol. #11 - Review|publisher=Mania Entertainment|author=Coulter, Bryce|date=2008-08-12|access-date=2008-09-25|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081217144039/http://www.mania.com/bleach-vol-11_article_80361.html|archive-date=2008-12-17}}</ref><ref name="VizMediaVol12">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7470 |title=Viz Media . products - Bleach, Vol. 12 (DVD) |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=2008-09-25 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090212085131/http://viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7470 |archive-date=2009-02-12 }}</ref><ref name="VizMediaVol13">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7471 |title=Viz Media . products - Bleach, Vol. 13 (DVD) |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=2008-11-27 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090210165907/http://viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7471 |archive-date=2009-02-10 }}</ref> Another DVD compilation was set for release on January 20, 2009.<ref name="VizMediaVol14">{{#invoke:Cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7947 |title=VizZ Media. products - Bleach, Vol. 14 (DVD) |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=2008-11-27 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081225183905/http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=7947 |archive-date=2008-12-25}}</ref>

{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 42
| EpisodeNumber2  = 1
| Title           = Yoruichi, Goddess of Flash, Dances!
| TranslitTitle   = Shunjin Yoruichi, Mau!
| NativeTitle     = 瞬神夜一、舞う！
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Akira Iwanaga
| WrittenBy       = [[Michiko Yokote]]
| Aux2            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|7|26}}
| AltDate         = July 22, 2007
| ShortSummary    = As [[Renji Abarai]] recovers in his cell, the spirit of his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#zanpakutō|zanpakutō]]'' [[List of Bleach characters#Zabimaru|Zabimaru]] says that he wishes to face [[Ichigo Kurosaki]]'s ''zanpakutō'' [[List of Bleach characters#Zangetsu|Zangetsu]] again, but Renji tells him that Ichigo is no longer his enemy. Elsewhere, [[List of Bleach characters#Yoruichi Shihōin|Yoruichi Shihōin]] manages to evade [[Byakuya Kuchiki]] and escape with Ichigo. After Ichigo regains consciousness, she begins to instruct him in the use of his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#bankai|bankai]]'', the final stage of his ''zanpakutō'' that would vastly increase his power. [[Orihime Inoue]] and [[Uryū Ishida]] are attempting to travel to [[Rukia Kuchiki]]'s cell by using Soul Reaper clothes, but they are closely watched by twelfth division captain [[Mayuri Kurotsuchi]].
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 43
| EpisodeNumber2  = 2
| Title           = The Despicable Shinigami
| TranslitTitle   = Hiretsu na Shinigami
| NativeTitle     = 卑劣な死神
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Jun'ya Koshiba
| WrittenBy       = Michiko Yokote
| Aux2            = [[Motosuke Takahashi]]
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|8|2}}
| AltDate         = July 29, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Orihime and Uryū continue towards Rukia's location, but are accosted by [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Makizō Aramaki|Makizō Aramaki]], a Soul Reaper of the eleventh division. Some twelfth division members arrive to help, but Mayuri, who has made them into human bombs, detonates them. Orihime uses her powers to protect Uryū and herself from the explosions, and Mayuri expresses his wish to experiment on Orihime. Uryū begins to fight Mayuri, but is quickly disabled by the paralyzing abilities of Mayuri's ''zanpakutō'' when his lieutenant, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Nemu Kurotsuchi|Nemu Kurotsuchi]], uses her body to hold down Uryū. Mayuri then reveals that he has experimented on many other Quincy, including Uryū's grandfather, [[List of Bleach characters#Sōken Ishida|Sōken Ishida]], and was responsible for his death.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 44
| EpisodeNumber2  = 3
| Title           = Ishida's Ultimate Power!
| TranslitTitle   = Ishida, Kyokugen no Chikara!
| NativeTitle     = 石田、極限の力！
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Kazunori Mizuno{{efn|Credited under the pen name {{Nihongo|"Ōkura Shirakawa"|白川 巨椋|Shirakawa Ōkura}}.}}
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| Aux2            = Satoshi Nishimura
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|8|9}}
| AltDate         = August 5, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Uryū uses the Quincy technique ''ransōtengai'' to overcome the paralysis of Mayuri's ''zanpakutō''. However, he is outclassed by Mayuri, and is forced to take off his ''sanrei'' glove, an act that releases the limits on his powers. Uryū proceeds to completely overwhelm Mayuri, even after Mayuri releases his ''bankai'', but Mayuri escapes by transforming into a liquid. Nemu gives Uryū the antidote to the poison of Mayuri's ''bankai'', and Uryū continues on towards Rukia's cell, severely weakened, until he is confronted by another Soul Reaper captain, [[Kaname Tōsen]].
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 45
| EpisodeNumber2  = 4
| Title           = Overcome Your Limits!
| TranslitTitle   = Genkai o Koero!
| NativeTitle     = 限界を越えろ！
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Kazunobu Shimizu
| WrittenBy       = Genki Yoshimura
| Aux2            = Tetsuhito Saitō
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|8|16}}
| AltDate         = August 12, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Tōsen disables Uryū instantly with his ''zanpakutō'', and has him incarcerated. Yoruichi summons Zangetsu using a ''tenshintai'', one of [[Kisuke Urahara]]'s inventions. Zangetsu states that if Ichigo defeats him, he will be able to perform his ''bankai'', and will be slain if he fails. Elsewhere, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Hanatarō Yamada|Hanatarō Yamada]] is admonished by his captain, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Retsu Unohana|Retsu Unohana]], for helping Ichigo, Renji breaks out of his prison cell, third division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Gin Ichimaru|Gin Ichimaru]] releases his lieutenant, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Izuru Kira|Izuru Kira]], from his imprisonment, and eleventh division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Kenpachi Zaraki|Kenpachi Zaraki]] agrees to help Orihime find Ichigo in order to fight Ichigo again.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}

| ShortSummary    = While incarcerated, fifth division lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Momo Hinamori|Momo Hinamori]] recalls her experiences at the Soul Reaper Academy, where she befriended Renji and Izuru. On a field trip to hunt hollows, she and her comrades were saved by captain [[Sousuke Aizen]] and then-lieutenant Ichimaru when powerful hollows attacked. Back in the present, Hinamori knocks her guard unconscious and escapes from her cell, planning to confront the person who killed Aizen.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}

She reveals in their subsequent conversation that Kisuke Urahara used to be the twelfth division captain. Elsewhere, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Tōshirō Hitsugaya|Tōshirō Hitsugaya]] confronts Ichimaru and Kira over Aizen's murder, but is interrupted by Hinamori, who believes that Hitsugaya killed Aizen. Hitsugaya knocks Hinamori unconscious and prepares to kill Ichimaru.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 48
| EpisodeNumber2  = 7
| Title           = Hitsugaya Roars!
| TranslitTitle   = Hitsugaya, Hoeru!
| NativeTitle     = 日番谷、吼える！
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| Aux2            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|9|6}}
| AltDate         = September 9, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Hitsugaya and Ichimaru begin to fight, and Ichimaru initially takes the upper hand with his swordplay. Hitsugaya turns the tables by using the ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#shikai|shikai]]'' of his ''zanpakutō'' to immobilize Ichimaru by freezing his arm, but this advantage is countered when Ichimaru uses his own ''shikai'' to threaten the unconscious Hinamori. Tenth division lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Rangiku Matsumoto|Rangiku Matsumoto]] arrives to aid Hinamori and Hitsugaya, and Ichimaru withdraws rather than go against her. Meanwhile, Renji arrives at Ichigo's training spot and reveals that Rukia's execution date has been moved to the next day.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 49
| EpisodeNumber2  = 8
| Title           = Rukia's Nightmare
| TranslitTitle   = Rukia no Akumu
| NativeTitle     = ルキアの悪夢
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Hodaka Kuramoto
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| Aux2            = Tetsuhito Saitō
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|9|13}}
| AltDate         = September 16, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Rukia reminisces about her past as a member of the thirteenth division. As she was able to get into the [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Thirteen Court Guard Squads|Thirteen Court Guard Squads]] due to being part of the Kuchiki clan, she was disliked by the other members of her division, but she was able to construct a deep friendship with lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Kaien Shiba|Kaien Shiba]]. One night, however, a hollow merged with Kaien and attempted to kill Rukia. Kaien regained control of his body, and impaled himself on Rukia's ''zanpakutō''. Rukia, believing that she is a coward who killed Kaien, is convinced that she should be executed.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}

| ShortSummary    = Kenpachi, along with Orihime and his subordinates, begins to travel to the execution grounds, but are confronted by captains [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Sajin Komamura|Sajin Komamura]] and Tōsen, with their respective lieutenants, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Tetsuzaemon Iba|Tetsuzaemon Iba]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Shūhei Hisagi|Shūhei Hisagi]]. [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Ikkaku Madarame|Ikkaku Madarame]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Yumichika Ayasegawa|Yumichika Ayasegawa]], Kenpachi's subordinates, begin fights with Iba and Hisagi respectively, and Komamura and Tōsen attack Kenpachi. Elsewhere, Renji has acquired his ''bankai'', and Yoruichi is confident that Ichigo will do the same.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 52
| EpisodeNumber2  = 11
| Title           = Renji, Oath of the Soul! Death Match with Byakuya
| TranslitTitle   = Renji, Tamashii no Chikai! Byakuya to no Shitō
| NativeTitle     = 恋次、魂の誓い！白哉との死闘
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Kōji Aritomi
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| Aux2            = Kōji Aritomi
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|10|4}}{{efn|name="Special"|Episodes 52 and 53 originally aired together as a one-hour special.}}
| AltDate         = October 14, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Renji travels to Rukia's execution area, and meets his captain Byakuya along the way. Renji ends up using his ''bankai'' to fight Byakuya, but his lack of experience with his ''bankai'' stymies his efforts. Byakuya uses his ''shikai'' to try and counterattack but fails and Renji reveals that his ''bankai'' is held together by his spiritual pressure. Byakuya uses his own ''bankai'' and attacks again, wounding Renji and causes his ''bankai'' to fade away. Finally Renji makes a last try and actually reaches his captain with his zanpakuto, but it breaks and Renji's wounds cause him to fall as the captain congratulates him.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}

| ShortSummary    = As Rukia travels to the execution area, Ichimaru shatters her resolve by offering to help her, but subsequently claiming that his offer was insincere to begin with. Kenpachi is easily battling both Komamura and Tōsen, forcing Tōsen to use his ''bankai'', which removes all of Kenpachi's senses with the exception of his sense of touch. | LineColor       = CFC0AB

| ShortSummary    = Rukia has accepted her execution, and gives a request to first division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto|Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto]] to send Ichigo and his friends home after her execution. The ''sōkyoku'', a massive halberd that transforms into a [[Fenghuang|phoenix]], is the execution method. However, Ichigo steps forward and stops the ''sōkyoku'' with his sword, and sympathetic captains [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Shunsui Kyōraku|Shunsui Kyōraku]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Jūshirō Ukitake|Jūshirō Ukitake]] destroy the ''sōkyoku''. As Renji arrives to take away Rukia, Ichigo defeats three pursuing lieutenants with his bare hands, and turns to face Byakuya.

| Aux2            = Motosuke Takahashi
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|11|8}}
| AltDate         = March 30, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Suì-Fēng recalls her past with Yoruichi. She was Yoruichi's personal guard, and highly faithful to her. However, when Yoruichi left the Soul Society, she felt betrayed, and carried a grudge against her mentor from that point forward. As Suì-Fēng attacks, Yoruichi uses her shunko to block all of Suì-Fēng's attacks. Suì-Fēng breaks down in tears, asking Yoruichi why she did not take her along when she left the Soul Society. Ikkaku and Iba are fighting, albeit casually for [[sake]]. Near the execution site, Ichigo uses his newly learned Getsuga Tenshō technique to defeat Byakuya's ''shikai'' and requests that Byakuya use his ''bankai''.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3

| AltDate         = April 6, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Byakuya uses his ''bankai'' and overwhelms Ichigo with millions of tiny blades. In response, Ichigo uses his own ''bankai'', which makes him incredibly fast. Ichigo evades Byakuya's ''bankai'' and stabs him with his sword. Meanwhile, Tōshirō Hitsugaya and Rangiku Matsumoto head to the Central 46 Chambers, the highest authority in the Soul Society.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 59
| EpisodeNumber2  = 18
| Title           = Conclusion of the Death Match! White Pride and Black Desire
| TranslitTitle   = Shitō Ketchaku! Shiroki Hokori to Kuroki Omoi
| NativeTitle     = 死闘決着！白き誇りと黒き想い
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Jun'ya Koshiba
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| Aux2            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|11|22}}
| AltDate         = April 13, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Byakuya uses the second form of his ''bankai'', summoning several rows of swords. As he and Ichigo continue to fight, Ichigo becomes progressively weaker as the strain from his ''bankai'' increases. His [[List of Bleach characters#Hollow Ichigo|inner hollow]] takes over his body after Byakuya wounds him, and he starts to overwhelm Byakuya. However, Ichigo manages to suppress his inner hollow, and regains control over his body. Both Ichigo and Byakuya focus the remainder of their powers and clash in a final strike, with Ichigo the victor. Byakuya reveals that he would allow Rukia to be executed because he values the law above her life "once a criminals punishment has been decided it must be carried out", and admits defeat, claiming that Ichigo has convinced him not to execute Rukia. Elsewhere, Hitsugaya and Matsumoto enter the Central 46 Chambers.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 60
| EpisodeNumber2  = 19
| Title           = Reality of the Despair, the Assassin's Dagger Is Swung
| TranslitTitle   = Zetsubō no Shinjitsu, Furiorosareta Kyōjin
| NativeTitle     = 絶望の真実、振り下ろされた凶刃
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|12|6}}
| DirectedBy      = Kazunori Mizuno{{efn|name=penname}}
| WrittenBy       = Genki Yoshimura
| Aux2            = Akio Kawamura
| AltDate         = April 20, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Hitsugaya and Matsumoto enter the Central 46 Chambers to find all of its occupants slain. Kira arrives, and Hitsugaya and Matsumoto pursue him. Hitsugaya returns when Kira tells him that Hinamori has entered the Central 46 Chambers. Ichimaru meets Hinamori and takes her further into the chambers, where she is reunited with Aizen. Aizen impales Hinamori with his sword, and Aizen and Ichimaru leave the chamber. Hitsugaya arrives, and is enraged at Hinamori's state. He uses his ''bankai'', but Aizen effortlessly defeats him. Unohana appears, denouncing Aizen after discovering that he is a traitor. Aizen then informs her that every Soul Reaper has been under the hypnosis of his ''zanpakutō'', with the exception of the blind Tōsen, Aizen's other accomplice.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 61
| EpisodeNumber2  = 20
| Title           = Aizen Stands! Horrible Ambitions
| TranslitTitle   = Aizen, Tatsu! Osorubeki Yabō
| NativeTitle     = 藍染、立つ！恐るべき野望
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Akira Shimizu
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| Aux2            = Tetsuya Endō
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|12|13}}
| AltDate         = April 27, 2008
| ShortSummary    = At Unohana's command, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Isane Kotetsu|Isane Kotetsu]] informs all high-ranking members of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads of Aizen's duplicity. Aizen arrives at Rukia's execution site, where Tōsen has brought Rukia and Renji. When Aizen asks Renji to leave Rukia, he refuses and begins to fight Aizen. Ichigo also arrives, and the two fight in unison against Aizen. Aizen defeats both of them, and begins to explain his reasons for betraying the Soul Society until he is interrupted by Komamura.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Bleach season 3
| EpisodeNumber   = 62
| EpisodeNumber2  = 21
| Title           = Gather Together! Group of the Strongest Shinigami!
| TranslitTitle   = Shūketsuseyo! Saikyō no Shinigami Shūdan
| NativeTitle     = 集結せよ！最強の死神集団
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Hodaka Kuramoto
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| Aux2            = Tetsuhito Saitō
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2005|12|20}}
| AltDate         = May 4, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Aizen defeats Komamura with an extremely powerful ''[[kidō]]'' spell and continues his explanation by revealing he arranged Rukia's execution to obtain the Hōgyoku, an orb that would allow him to gain hollow powers that was hidden in Rukia's gigai by Urahara. After extracting the Hōgyoku from her body, Aizen orders Ichimaru to kill Rukia before Byakuya saves her as the majority of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads then arrive to restrain Aizen. But Aizen and his accomplices use several hollows to escape into the hollows' world [[Bleach (manga)#Plot|Hueco Mundo]]. Afterwards, as Byakuya recovers, he explains to Rukia that he married her sister, Hisana, and adopted Rukia into the Kuchiki clan as Hisana's dying wish. But explaining that as he promised his parents to uphold the law without question as he broke his clan's rules in adopting her, Byakuya admits that he was conflicted between following the rules and allowing Rukia's execution or breaking them to save her.
| LineColor       = CFC0AB
}}
